description:
**Greenfield reference implementation.** Write a fresh `memory::MemoryBackend` for `jmap-tasks-server` from scratch, following the canonical pattern landed by .1 (mail-server).

This crate currently has no `tests/` directory at all. Implementation work, not refactor.

## Mechanical steps

1. Read the canonical pattern from .1 (jmap-mail-server's `src/memory.rs`).
2. Read the `TasksBackend` trait surface in `crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/`.
3. Implement a minimal `MemoryBackend`. `Arc<Mutex<MemoryState>>`, HashMap storage, hand-rolled change tracking, ID generation.
4. Add `feature = "memory"` to Cargo.toml. Gate `pub mod memory;` in lib.rs.
5. Create `tests/common/mod.rs` (≤ 200 LOC helpers) and `tests/tasks_tests.rs` with happy-path + error-path coverage.
6. Add `[dev-dependencies] jmap-tasks-server = { workspace = true, features = ["memory"] }`.
7. Use JMAP Tasks draft examples as test oracle. Hand-written JSON fixtures.

## Test minimum

- `TaskList/get`, `TaskList/changes`, `TaskList/set`, `TaskList/query`, `TaskList/queryChanges` (5 tests)
- `Task/get`, `Task/changes`, `Task/set`, `Task/query` (4 tests)
- 2-4 error-path: invalidProperties, notFound, forbidden, willDestroy with linked tasks

Total: ~11-13 tests, ~400-650 LOC for tests file.

## Coordination with architecture work

JMAP-yfpq (tasks consumes jmap-jscalendar-types) is mostly API-preserving — re-exports keep type names stable. JMAP-lbdy adds `extra` field additively. This child's tests should use `serde_json::from_value` from JSON fixtures to stay immune to additive changes.

## Acceptance

- `cargo test -p jmap-tasks-server --features memory` clean — at least 9 tests pass.
- `cargo test -p jmap-tasks-server` clean.
- `cargo check -p jmap-tasks-server --no-default-features` clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-tasks-server --features memory --tests -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo doc -p jmap-tasks-server --features memory --no-deps` clean.
- Naming, layout, feature flag exactly match canonical (.1).
- Total new LOC: 800-1500 (reference impl) + 400-650 (tests) ≈ 1200-2150 LOC.

## Depends on

JMAP-hwdv.1 (mail-server canonical).

## Effort estimate

1-3 days.
title: Greenfield MemoryBackend + tests in jmap-tasks-server (mirror canonical)
